title: Los Angeles Fires 2025 (20250112-FS-KG-09)
description:
Firefighting Crews from Mexico have mobilized under a (California) State agreement. In this photo firefighters from CONAFOR (Mexico's Forest Service) unload gear at the Noble Creek Mobilization Center in preparation of moving out to one of the Southern California Wildfires.
A Mobilization Center (MOB) has been established at Noble Creek to support ongoing firefighting efforts in the Southern California Basin. A MOB Center serves as a crucial hub where resources, including personnel, equipment and supplies are gathered and organized before deployment to a wildfire incident.

 
Resources have been mobilized from various federal, state, tribal and local agencies. This collaboration highlights the importance of interstate and interagency partnerships in wildfire response.

 
MOB Centers are essential during large scale emergencies, such as the current wildfires in Southern California Basin, to streamline operations and optimize resource allocation.

 

USDA Forest Service video by Kerry Greene.
